name: Lemony Orzo with Asparagus, Garlic Bread Crumbs & Sardines
modifications: Scaled from 2 to 4 servings (batch: dinner for 2 + next-day office lunches for 2). 2 cans sardines.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the orzo and cook until al dente per package directions. Two minutes before done, add the sliced asparagus. Drain. Wipe out and reserve the pot.
Make the dressing: in a large bowl, stir together 3 tablespoons olive oil with the lemon zest and juice. Season with salt and pepper. Add the drained orzo and asparagus, toss to coat. Set aside.

In the reserved pot, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium. Add the panko and cook, stirring, until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in the grated garlic, season with salt and pepper.
Break the drained sardines into bite-sized chunks. Add to the orzo along with the Parmesan and fresh herbs. Toss gently to combine.
Taste and season with more salt, pepper or lemon juice as needed. Top with the toasted garlic bread crumbs and extra Parmesan if desired. Pack 2 portions for tomorrow's lunches.

nutrition_per_serving.source: estimated — same per-serving as base recipe (nutrition scales linearly)

notes: Batch cook — dinner tonight + office lunches tomorrow. Counts as 1 fish serving (sardines). Works well at room temperature for packed lunches.
